reason: I'd probably stop using the app in two weeks like every other one, so paying for extras on top feels like throwing money away. The free app already does the stuff I actually need.
objection: I drop every ADHD app after two weeks. Skins, rooms and widgets are nice but I'd buy them and then never open the app again.
would_change_my_mind: If I'd already been using the free app daily for a month and my pet was something I actually cared about, I might buy a new species for a couple of dollars.
